name: CoP + Progression: Provider A withdraws X (unapproved), Provider B completes Y, Provider A PUTs tweak to X and adds new Z
description: Multi-feature interaction: Provider A (UKPRN 10005077) POSTs ZSC00001 as withdrawn (unapproved — no approval event). Provider B (UKPRN 10005078) POSTs ZSC00002 as completed for the same learner (unapproved, different course). Provider A then PUTs a bundled payload carrying ZSC00001 (withdrawal date tweaked: 2025-11-15 → 2025-11-20), ZSC00002 (CoP — Provider A also now submitting this course, start 2026-04-01, completionDate 2026-05-31), and ZSC00003 (brand-new third course). RUN WITH: ShortCourseChangeOfProvider=OFF, ShortCourseProgression=ON. With CoP off, Provider A's ZSC00002 item in the PUT is silently ignored — only the ZSC00001 update and the ZSC00003 progression land. Provider A's ZSC00002 item carries a completionDate (2026-05-31) intentionally different from Provider B's (2026-03-15), acting as a canary: if the ignored item incorrectly mutates Provider B's episode the completion-date assertions will fail. Expects 3 distinct ShortCourseEpisode rows (ZSC00001 Provider A, ZSC00002 Provider B only, ZSC00003 Provider A) in both DBs, and Provider B's ZSC00002 completion date unchanged at 2026-03-15. PREREQUISITE: ZSC00003 must exist in the test environment's courses reference data — the story will fail at step 4 until it is added.

steps.name: SLD (Provider A) POSTs ZSC00001 — withdrawn, unapproved
SLD (Provider B) POSTs ZSC00002 — completed, unapproved, different course
Get Learner Key (from Provider A's ZSC00001 episode)

SLD (Provider A) PUTs ZSC00001 (withdrawal date tweaked to 2025-11-20), ZSC00002 (CoP — silently ignored with CoP off; carries completionDate 2026-05-31 as canary), and ZSC00003 (new course) in one payload

assertions.name: ZSC00001: 1 ShortCourseEpisode row in Learning DB (Provider A only)
ZSC00002: 1 ShortCourseEpisode row in Learning DB (Provider B only — Provider A's CoP episode silently ignored)
ZSC00002: completionDate in Learning DB is still Provider B's 2026-03-15 (not mutated by Provider A's 2026-05-31)
ZSC00003: 1 ShortCourseEpisode row in Learning DB (Provider A, created by PUT)
3 ShortCourseEpisode rows total in Learning DB for this learner
ZSC00001: 1 ShortCourseEpisode row in Earnings DB (start 2025-08-01)
ZSC00002: 1 ShortCourseEpisode row in Earnings DB (Provider B only — CoP episode silently ignored)
ZSC00002: completionDate in Earnings DB is still Provider B's 2026-03-15 (not mutated by Provider A's 2026-05-31)
ZSC00003: 1 ShortCourseEpisode row in Earnings DB (start 2026-01-01)
